class.name: DebugMenuOverlay
class.brief_description: Native overlay drawn by the [DebugMenu] singleton.
class.description: The overlay is a self-contained [CanvasLayer] built entirely in C++: it creates its own [Control] hierarchy, fonts and draw calls, so it needs no scene, script or theme resource. Builds as part of the engine rather than as an add-on: the default project font is used, the layout follows the debug menu add-on and the graphs are drawn with [method CanvasItem.draw_polyline]. Use [DebugMenu] to control it; it is exposed mainly so the overlay can be found and inspected at runtime.
